description: Use when you need native and stablecoin balances for a list of wallets: up to 25 addresses (0x or ENS names) in one POST, each answered exactly like /wallet/balance (exact per-chain amounts from publi. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (POST /wallet/balance/batch, $0.075 per call), with the response schema and an example; POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge.

chains.description: optional, for every address: comma list of chains, as in the single call

name: wallet_balance_batch
